settings.onb_telemetry_b_id.text: To see how use changes over time, bise picks a random ID on your Mac. It isn't tied to you, your Mac or any account, and it's renewed at least every 13 months. Turning this off deletes it, and "Delete my data" also deletes what I have.

settings.onb_telemetry_b_what.text: What bise sends, once a day: totals. How many agents you ran and how many hours they worked. How long the app was open, and in front. How often you used each feature: artifacts, schedules, the inbox, plugins.

settings.onb_telemetry_b_why.text: It's just me, Gabriel, building bise. I don't know yet if bise is useful to you, or which parts you actually use. Counting is the only way I have to learn that, and to know what to fix first.

settings.onb_telemetry_line.text: Only aggregated usage counts, to help me make bise better. Never your content, files, names or anything personal.
